sections.heading: Foreign resident capital gains withholding
sections.text:
Find out about the foreign resident capital gains withholding (FRCGW), including who it applies to and when it applies.

Find out what foreign resident capital gains withholding (FRCGW) is and how it applies when disposing of property.

Australians selling property need a clearance certificate to avoid having an amount withheld from the sale price.

Check who can apply for a FRCGW variation when selling Australian property.

Find out when providing a declaration means a purchase is not subject to foreign resident capital gains withholding.

Learn the notification requirements for non-indirect Australian real property interest (non-IARPI) vendor declarations.

Find out how to pay the withholding amount when foreign resident capital gains withholding (FRCGW) applies.

Certain Australian Government authorities can use legislation for the compulsory acquisition of property.
